long_biography.plain_text:
Funding the State Hermitage's acquisition of Kazimir Malevich's Black Square made Vladimir Potanin's cultural patronage tangible in a single landmark work. The Russian industrialist later helped assemble more than 250 Soviet and Russian contemporary artworks for the Centre Pompidou.

Potanin established his grant-making foundation in 1999 to support education, museums, social sport and the development of strategic philanthropy. It later adopted an endowment model intended to sustain programmes independently over time. Its work has included university fellowships, training for museum professionals and grants that help cultural institutions serve their communities.
long_biography.html:
Funding the State Hermitage's acquisition of Kazimir Malevich's Black Square made Vladimir Potanin's cultural patronage tangible in a single landmark work. The Russian industrialist later helped assemble more than 250 Soviet and Russian contemporary artworks for the Centre Pompidou.

Potanin established his grant-making foundation in 1999 to support education, museums, social sport and the development of strategic philanthropy. It later adopted an endowment model intended to sustain programmes independently over time. Its work has included university fellowships, training for museum professionals and grants that help cultural institutions serve their communities.
